title: Using Facebook Ads for Groomers: A Guide to Growing Your Pet Grooming Business

facts.fact: The page states that Facebook has over 2.9 billion active users, a figure the author gives without citing a source or date.
facts.quote: With over **2.9 billion active users**, Facebook is one of the most powerful platforms to advertise your services.

facts.fact: The page recommends targeting users within a 10-15 mile radius of a pet grooming business for Facebook Ads.
facts.quote: **Location**: Target users within a 10-15 mile radius.

facts.fact: The page suggests targeting pet owners aged 25-60 who are likely to have disposable income.
facts.quote: Pet owners aged 25-60, likely to have disposable income.

facts.fact: The page recommends beginning a Facebook Ads campaign for a groomer with a modest budget of $10-$20 per day.
facts.quote: Begin with a modest budget of $10-$20 per day.

facts.fact: The page gives a sample ad copy offering 10% off a customer's first grooming session, presented as an example rather than a standard offer.
facts.quote: Book today and get 10% off your first grooming session.

facts.fact: The page was published on December 17, 2024, and lists a reading time of 4 minutes.
